ALERT: Disk Space Critical on prod-k8s-node-07

Severity: Critical
Timestamp: 2026-04-15T14:22:00Z
Source: Prometheus AlertManager

The root filesystem on host prod-k8s-node-07 has reached 95% utilization. The server is a Linux (Ubuntu 22.04) machine running containerized workloads in the us-west-2 AWS region. The container-platform application logs and temp files appear to be the primary consumers. Disk I/O is elevated. Application health checks are intermittently failing.

This is a production environment server in the cloud-aws infrastructure. The operating system is linux and the mount point affected is /var/lib/docker.
